mapper.select: SELECT i.id,o.id order_id,o.order_no,o.factory_id, (SELECT MIN(s.factory_name_snapshot) FROM checkout_batch_item_snapshot s WHERE s.checkout_batch_id=o.checkout_batch_id AND s.factory_id=o.factory_id) factory_name, i.version,i.created_at,c.id case_id,c.version case_version,i.issue_status status,i.issue_scene scene, i.fulfillment_effect effect,i.primary_issue_type,i.issue_summary summary, (SELECT a.id FROM arbitration_case a WHERE a.source_issue_report_id=i.id) arbitration_id, (SELECT a.operation_reason FROM admin_case_action a WHERE a.admin_case_id=c.id AND a.action_type='request_issue_evidence' ORDER BY CAST(a.request_payload_json->>'$.issue_version' AS UNSIGNED) DESC LIMIT 1) supplement_request ORDER BY i.created_at DESC,i.id DESC LIMIT #{page.pageSize} OFFSET #{page.offset}

SELECT p.relation_id issue_id,e.id evidence_id FROM admin_case_relation p JOIN admin_case_relation r ON r.admin_case_id=p.admin_case_id AND r.relation_type='order_evidence_record' JOIN order_evidence_record e ON e.id=r.relation_id AND e.draft_removed_at IS NULL WHERE p.relation_type='order_issue_report' AND p.is_primary=1 AND p.relation_id IN #{id} ORDER BY p.relation_id,e.created_at,e.id
mapper.update: UPDATE order_issue_report SET issue_status=#{status},version=version+1,updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
UPDATE admin_case SET case_status=#{status},version=version+1,updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{issue.caseId} AND version=#{issue.caseVersion} AND case_status NOT IN ('closed','cancelled')
